description.p: HopDesk connects you to Windows, macOS, Linux and virtual machines from your Linux desktop. Save the computers you use, and connect with one click.

ul.li: VNC for macOS, Linux, Raspberry Pi and NAS devices
RDP for Windows, powered by FreeRDP
SPICE for QEMU and libvirt virtual machines
Passwords stored in your system keyring, never in plain text
Automatic reconnect when the network drops
